name: 三合
meaning: Three-branch elemental affinity: 申子辰 Water, 亥卯未 Wood, 寅午戌 Fire, 巳酉丑 Metal.
caution: Two members share a 三合 group, but do not by themselves form a complete 三合局.
reference: Traditional Earthly Branch relationship convention. Interpretive guidance is symbolic, not a guaranteed forecast.
